about: The crypt's Proving hall (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB11): The challenge room behind a gather door: a wide floating slab where the party fights a fight of elites together, for a bigger reward. Its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), sockets on its east and north and south and west sides for the bridges. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_challenge_ground.tscn and its art from this.
